strategy_roster.name: ATR MACD
strategy_roster.notes: The MACD(12,26,9) crossover and opposite crossover are preserved, with the documented 2% stop retained. The unspecified ATR filter/volatility period, short side, and intraday timing are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Ema612CrossoverStrategy
strategy_roster.notes: The source explicitly calculates SMA despite its EMA name; documented SMA(6)/SMA(54) bullish and bearish crosses are retained. Absolute take-profit, trailing, and short handling are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: VR ZVER
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,10) > ema(close,20) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10)/EMA(20)/EMA(50) and RSI(14) are explicit fallbacks for the unnamed confirmation layers and retain the bullish long stack. Stochastic, exact thresholds, break-even, pip protection, and short entries are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Expert Trend Filter
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) levels 30/70 and EMA(9)/EMA(21) are chosen fallbacks because the docs provide names but no values; the bullish RSI/trend setup and loss of either condition exit. Pip protection, martingale, and exact MA mode are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Divergence
strategy_roster.notes: A new prior 20-bar low with rising RSI(14) is the bullish price/RSI divergence proxy; the mirrored high/RSI condition exits. The documented 2% stop is retained, while pivot confirmation, RiskReward 2, and the short side are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: TTM Squeeze
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) > ema(close,20) + 1.5 * atr(high,low,close,20) and roc(close,1) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 30
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) outside an EMA(20)+1.5-ATR Keltner proxy, positive ROC, and RSI(14)>30 represent the documented squeeze release. Linear-regression momentum, exact zero-cross state, optional 1.2% target, and short entries are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Reverse Day Fractal
strategy_roster.notes: A new three-bar low followed by a bullish close is the long failed-breakout reversal proxy; a bearish close or prior-high break exits. Exact three-candle state, point stops, target, and trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: MT45
strategy_roster.notes: The source alternates direction on every completed bar; positive one-bar open ROC is a state-free long-side proxy and the inverse exits. Alternation history, martingale sizing, and fixed point stop/target cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: CloseProfit V2
strategy_roster.notes: CloseProfit V2 is explicitly a portfolio PnL protection utility that never opens positions. An impossible negative-price guard avoids inventing a signal; currency thresholds and multi-symbol liquidation are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Dynamic Ticks Oscillator Model (DTOM)
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(close,5) is a current-price proxy for the unavailable NYSE Down Ticks index, and its 24-bar standard deviation supplies the documented dynamic thresholds. Stops, the source index, and session details are omitted.
